This video covers a solo live walkthrough of the Kuldra fight. I am a noob lol, so if you found any other nice strats make sure to post in the comments!

I have a channel with my best bud, we regularly post videos/livestreams here:  https://www.youtube.com/@BennyandtheChickenboy
